FX-RWAVE-001.says: The settings as they start: producer point (50, 50), 64 sides, a wave every 24 frames growing 5 pixels a frame, orientation 0, direction 90, velocity 0, spin 0, lifespan 96, opacity 100, fade-in 0, fade-out 48, widths 5 and 5, square, white. At frame 0 the first wave is born, a white dot 5 pixels across in the middle; at frame 2 it is a ring 10 pixels out that only the frame's corners reach; by frame 4 it has left the frame.

FX-RWAVE-002.says: Opacity 0: no waves, the drawing untouched.

FX-RWAVE-003.says: Start width 0 and end width 0: no waves, the drawing untouched.

FX-RWAVE-004.says: "The ring": four sides, orientation 45, a wave every 10 frames growing 2 pixels a frame, lifespan 10, no fades, widths 1 and 1. At frame 2 it is a square round the middle, (8, 5), its sides 2.83 pixels out, each side's pixel-wide line shared between two rows or columns, 0.672 and 0.328, over the night and the empty half alike.

FX-RWAVE-005.says: As the ring, three sides, orientation 0: a triangle, its top corner at (8, 1) and its foot along y = 7, half in row 6 and half in row 7.

FX-RWAVE-006.says: As the ring, orientation 0 and spin 22.5 degrees a frame: at frame 2 the wave has turned 45 degrees, FX-RWAVE-004 exactly.

FX-RWAVE-007.says: As the ring, velocity 1 toward direction 90: at frame 2 the wave's middle has drifted 2 pixels right, the same as the ring sent from (62.5, 50).

FX-RWAVE-008.says: Round, 64 sides, a wave every other frame, lifespan 5, otherwise the ring: at frame 4 three waves, a dot in the middle born this frame, a ring 4 pixels out and one 8 pixels out that touches the frame's left and right edges.

FX-RWAVE-009.says: As FX-RWAVE-008, lifespan 3: the wave born at frame 0 has died by frame 4, and only the dot and the ring 4 pixels out are left.

FX-RWAVE-010.says: As the ring, start width 4, end width 0, lifespan 4: born 4 pixels wide, at frame 2, halfway through its life, it is 2 pixels wide.

FX-RWAVE-011.says: As the ring, lifespan 4, fade-in 2, fade-out 2: at half strength at frame 1, whole at frame 2, FX-RWAVE-004, and at half again at frame 3.

FX-RWAVE-012.says: As the ring, widths 4 and 4, triangle: each side brightest on its line, fading to nothing 2 pixels either side.

FX-RWAVE-013.says: As FX-RWAVE-012, sine: softer at the middle, brighter than the triangle wherever either reaches.

FX-RWAVE-014.says: As the ring in orange #ffb040 at opacity 50: the square painted half strength, orange.

FX-RWAVE-015.says: As FX-RWAVE-008, the producer point keyed from (25, 50) at frame 0 to (75, 50) at frame 4, linear: every wave alive is sent from where the point is now, so frame 4's three are round (12, 5).

FX-RWAVE-016.says: As the ring, the opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 past its end: frame 0 is the drawing, and frame 2 is held at 100, FX-RWAVE-004.

FX-RWAVE-017.says: As the ring, orientation 405, a turn and 45 degrees: FX-RWAVE-004.

FX-RWAVE-018.says: As the ring, the layer moved three pixels right: the square moves with it, round (11, 5).

FX-RWAVE-019.says: As the ring, round, after a Motion Tile at 300% by 300%, the producer point at (0, 50), the drawing's left edge, the layer moved eight pixels right: a ring round (8, 5) of the frame, drawn across the tile on the left and the drawing on the right alike.

FX-RWAVE-020.says: As the ring, 4.7 sides, counted as 4: FX-RWAVE-004 exactly.

FX-RWAVE-021.says: Sides 2, below 3. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RWAVE-022.says: Interval 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RWAVE-023.says: Lifespan 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RWAVE-024.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RWAVE-025.says: Start width -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RWAVE-026.says: Profile "bell", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
